verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI for managing Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs, and says it can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines for automation. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: command reference and installation details, evidence of agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
